replace_dropout_for_eval: replace dropout training patterns with noops in an exported fx GraphModule for eval mode
replace_batchnorm_for_eval: replace batchnorm training patterns with eval patterns in an exported fx GraphModule
move_exported_model_to_eval: move an exported fx GraphModule to eval mode by rewriting dropout and batchnorm patterns
test_replace_dropout_for_eval: test the _replace_dropout_for_eval function rewrites training dropout to eval noops in an fx graph
test_replace_batchnorm_for_eval: test the _replace_batchnorm_for_eval function rewrites training batchnorm to eval in an fx graph
